title: Site Public Metadata Schema
description: Page-level SEO and social metadata fields. These are additive fields that can be added to page models for public-facing content.

public_title.description: The public-facing page title used in title tags and social previews.

public_description.description: The public-facing page description used in meta description and social previews.

canonical_path.description: The canonical URL path for this page, used in rel=canonical link elements.

og_title.description: Open Graph title override. Falls back to public_title if not specified.

og_description.description: Open Graph description override. Falls back to public_description if not specified.

og_image.description: URL or path to the Open Graph image for social previews.

og_type.description: Open Graph type for this page.

robots.description: Robots meta directive for this page.

audience_tags.description: Tags identifying the target audiences for this page.

structured_data_types.description: JSON-LD structured data types to include on this page.

claim_boundary_level.description: The claim boundary level for content on this page.

theme_color.description: Theme color for browser chrome and PWA manifests.
